notablePrerequisites: An opponent has at least two nonland cards in their graveyard that were put there from the battlefield this turn.
description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Wreck Hunter.
Wreck Hunter enters the battlefield, creating at least two tapped Powerstone artifact tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing two Powerstones, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
